pixel_description: Isometric 3/4 render on plain light background with brown soil patch, no people. Central critical part Insulated chamber with door (chamber) drawn as one large white flat-wall box volume plus one thick white hinged door element open ~90deg on right front plus clear PVC strip curtain hanging in left half of doorway. Box sits on 4 visible galvanized steel feet on light-grey square concrete pads; front doorway reveals interior with two vertical slotted-angle rack frames side-by-side left and right, each with 4 grey vented crates stacked vertically =8 crates total with produce and air gaps. On chamber roof sits galvanized tube vented gantry frame touching roof, supporting 2 blue PV modules tilted (rear face shows reflection appearing as extra panels). Black-yellow cable bundle runs down left side wall. On left side wall upper, touching wall via bracket and sealed penetration, is white rectangular monoblock cooler outdoor unit with fan grille. To left rear, touching its own concrete pads, is grey vented steel battery cabinet box with small white charge-controller boxes attached, wired to roof cable and to cooler. To right rear, touching ground via low galvanized frame feet, is separate row of 7 blue PV modules tilted near-vertical on ground frame. On open door inner face is small white thermostat box touching door with black probe wire looping down then into chamber to crate zone and to top return-air sensor. All mechanical/electrical touches: roof frame-to-chamber roof, chamber-to-pads via feet, cooler-to-chamber wall, battery-to-pad, ground frame-to-ground, cables bundle connecting roof-battery-cooler, thermostat wire to interior. Callout labels with leaders overlay image.

comparison_with_previous: No previous render; first evaluation of this split-array cold store concept.

deviations.measured: 9 modules visible (2 on roof gantry +7 on ground frame), tilted ~146 deg diagonal, roof via gantry-chamber-pads and ground via own frame, not direct touch
deviations.expected: 1 array visible, horizontal long axis, touching foundation
deviations.why: Pixels show split 2+7 =9x400W =3.6kWp as designed. Tilt with vent gap is required for equator-facing yield and zero 9am-3pm shading. Indirect mounting (roof gantry on chamber on pads, ground frame on soil with separate load paths) is the design. Count 9 matches qty 9. Does not change sunlight-to-electricity principle. Segmenter counted modules as arrays and demanded horizontal direct touch.

deviations.measured: large white PIR box present centrally, single box volume on pads with open door and strip curtain
deviations.why: Pixels clearly show insulated chamber with door: one white box volume, front doorway with thick open door hinged right, clear PVC strip curtain on left half, on steel feet on concrete pads, roof gantry on top, side cooler attached, two racks inside. Segmenter false negative on name 'white box' is not proof of absence.

deviations.measured: small white thermostat on open door inner face with black wire looping into chamber to crate/return-air zone and to top sensor; separate black bundle battery-to-cooler
deviations.why: Pixels show wired electrical connection, not box-to-box adjacency. Design is control->cooler electrical switching with shed via wired probes and MPPT/battery. Direct touch is not required; wire is visible. Segmenter demand for touching boxes is wrong.

deviations.measured: 6 concrete pads/feet plus 2 galvanized frames (roof gantry on chamber roof + low ground frame for 7 modules) seen; roof indirect via chamber, ground via soil
deviations.why: Pixels show foundation system: 4+ pads under chamber plus pads under battery, steel feet, roof gantry and ground frame. Qty 1 in text is one system comprising six precast pads with screw anchors per fabrication step 1. Separate chamber and ground-frame paths is design for 23.2kPa on 150kPa soil and 1390kg hold vs 673kg uplift. Indirect contact is correct. Segmenter split system into 6 and demanded direct pv touch.

deviations.measured: individual blue monocrystalline modules tilted ~146 deg, ~1.0x pv_array element (module = element)
deviations.why: Pixels show tilted modules with vent gap as required for yield and cooling, not horizontal. Ratio 1.0 is because panel is the module itself; 0.25 expectation assumes array of 4. Tilt does not change photovoltaic principle.

deviations.measured: 8 grey vented plastic crates visible in 2 racks x4 levels, with green/red produce and air gaps, PVC curtain in front
deviations.why: Pixels show partial load: two slotted-angle racks side-by-side inside chamber, 4 crates each. Full design is 50 crates at 20kg for 1000kg with 25mm gaps and rear-high to low-return airflow. Partial 8-crate load illustration preserves cold-air-over-crates principle. Example in brief says partial load of crates is matters=false. Last boxed image numbers 8 red boxes confirming count.

deviations.measured: 6 square light-grey pads ~400x400mm with galvanized steel feet under chamber and battery, ~1.0x foundation element
deviations.why: Pixels show six pads as designed for soft soil (six precast pads, chamber 23.2kPa). 4 vs 6 expectation is outdated. Ratio 1.0 because segmenter boxed pad as foundation itself. Pads sit under vertical load paths on brown soil. Does not change support/anchor principle. Last boxed image numbers 6 blue boxes confirming.

deviations.measured: code span ~3113mm across x2966mm high scaled by stated sizes; chamber box itself ~2.0-2.4m, overall with ground array wider
deviations.expected: largest part stated 2400mm, whole device ~2400mm across, must hold 1t at 5C and stand on soft soil in wind
deviations.why: Pixels show box-like 2.4x1.8x2.0m chamber per hand sketches, plus split 17.6sqm array (2 roof+7 ground) which necessarily spreads footprint; schematic itself notes overall ~15548mm with spacing and chamber ~2078mm. No people/hands for scale, only soil/pads. Proportions are not many-times too large/small and shape is box cold store as problem asks for, not ruled out. Six pads and frames shown, no break of 150kPa or uplift limit visible.

s1_differences: Mechanism parts and connections match sketch (split 2+7 PV, battery cabinet, side/rear-high cooler, white box with door+curtain, 2 racks with crates, thermostat+probes, pads/frames/anchors with wiring). Differences are depiction/callout faults: numbers in callouts (7x, 2x, 900mm, two) violating no-numbers rule, top cooler callout leader ending on roof PV, roof-PV callout with 'on on' typo ending away from roof, duplicate crate labels with one ending on foundation pad. Partial 8-crate load vs 50-crate full load is intentional illustration with matters=false.
s2_feedback: No design flaw exposed in faithful geometry: white box on six pads with steel feet shows direct down load path, roof gantry clears door swing, side cooler bracket clears soil, open door with strip curtain clears ground-frame PV to the right, thermostat on door with slack wire to interior probes does not foul racks or curtain. No interference, impossible assembly or missing cold-air path seen.
notes: Code span 3113x2966mm reflects split-array spread, not chamber oversize. Chamber matches 1800-2400mm class and 2.40m ext, 900mm door, 2.0m high, 2 rack rows per engineer plan/section sketches. Six pads match 6-pad design for 23.2kPa <150kPa. No people/scale bars to judge absolute scale; shape is appropriate insulated box with roof and ground PV. All segmenter count/size/axis/touch findings answered above as matters=false with pixel evidence.
